messages:
OpsLead: Scheduled edge-router config rollout: 2026-04-01 03:00-05:00 UTC. Scope: global edge proxies (routing table + idle connection gc). Expected: short-lived connection resets and increased p99 for streaming endpoints for ~2-5m per region during canary. No data loss expected. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/edge-rollout-2026-04-01
Infra-Oncall: Taking oncall for the window. Plan: staggered region rollouts (EU -> US -> APAC), 5-min canaries with health checks (200 on /health, streaming reconnect smoke), then proceed. Rollback play: set rollout.pause=true in control plane.
Kate: Can someone add a Console banner + status page blip and prep the customer-template for dedicated/private tenants? We should mention streaming reconnection guidance for SDKs. :loudspeaker:
SRE-PS: Recommend setting an SLO grace window 03:00-05:30 UTC and temporarily suppress pages for single-route p99 spikes. We'll trigger post-action perf diff if any SLO burn > 1.5x baseline.
k8s-deploy-bot: Heads-up: automated router-config rollout job scheduled at 03:05 UTC unless manually acked by 02:50 UTC.
status-bot: Status page draft posted: "Planned maintenance: possible brief stream reconnections and transient latency increases. No customer data impact." Link: https://status.redwood/incident/edge-rollout-0401
OpsLead: Note: contact list for Dedicated/private VPC customers attached in runbook. Exclude pinned edge nodes for tenant-alpha and tenant-omega. Add warmup for long-lived sessions: run reconnect harness for 2 minutes after canary.
Infra-Oncall: Preflight will run 23:00 UTC tonight (region EU only). Ill post preflight output here and update every rollout stage with timestamps. If we see streaming reconnect rate > 3% during canary, pause and rollback.
Kate: I'll notify Solutions and CS to be on standby and prepare an FAQ snippet for customers.
OpsLead: Thanks all. Keep replies short in this thread during the window. Follow runbook checklist and DM if you need hands.
